Sam Altman's World (the identity project he co-founded) has launched a World ID verification suite aimed at banks, bundling tools to verify both human and agent identities - its first industry-specific product. The Block reports Bain Capital and VanEck Funds are named among its design partners. The move positions World ID's proof-of-personhood infrastructure for financial-services KYC at a moment when banks increasingly need to distinguish both real humans and authorized AI agents from fraud.
